remarks: Welcome to the Sasha K in Legacy Ridge, a beautifully designed 1,564 sq. ft. home that offers the perfect balance of style, comfort, and future potential. Featuring 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, an open-concept main floor with 9' ceilings, a designer kitchen complete with quartz countertops, a large island and corner pantry, plus a spacious great room anchored by a modern electric fireplace, this home is built for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find a generous primary bedroom with a walk-in closet and private ensuite, two additional bedrooms, a versatile bonus room, and convenient second-floor laundry. What truly sets this home apart is the separate side entrance and upgraded 9' basement with additional windows, creating excellent potential for a basement development or expanded living space. Home is currently under construction. Photos are virtually staged for illustration purposes. Furniture, appliances and decor not included* (id:67522)
